_doc: ELEM-S81 canonical legacy core recipes for gen_core_kit_legacy.py. Key = plan hard-core module (or plan_module). ref_tile from results/signoff_1024/inventory.json (bksel_q: the hk2l kit whose views closed; l5: the n32 kit at 1766568f01 = main's binding). Defaults: util = spec route.pd, CTS args of VQ r12, hold margin 15, fanout 24. 10-25 (S81-CORES/LEGACY): qbank_N/S + sstn_base566 ft1_pairs dropped: main RTL (dc23a738f / e7390b932) lands every station input in its own pin register (2 flops per bit, +1 cycle), so no one-station pair exists and canonical face_guard needs none. dsfd_rstg / ot_s81_sstn_payload536: relay2 (0c1b14693) 2-flop stations, suffix r2, no ft1_pairs. 10-26 (CORES-KITS/S81 HOLD): recipe io_hold sender_min = IO-HOLD option A (COORD 10-25 10:23) on vector input buses; qbank_S / cfg7_seq_bfp k26 GRT hold repairs hit RSZ-0060 on 100%/98% input-port -> landing-register endpoints under the flat -40 contract.

dsfd_bf_front_roots.why_deadpin: S81-CORE-LAT-R21 (COORD R20 ruling b): x0[281:280], cfg[52:48], cfg[46:34] have no reader in the STATIC_PROGRAM front and no die-level proven-dead declaration -> own kept io_clk face register each (no cycle on any used path); the die bind must build dsfd_bf_front_roots with the same defines
dsfd_bf_front_roots.why_n32: S81-CORE-LAT-R20: N32=1 = the native-census (<=32 loads) form of the CLOSED RTAG front (n32_soq_roomy kit defines); same ports as the plan view. N32=0 is not lint-clean (N32==0 alias always@* and the unconditional sequential copy writes both drive w_ca_r2/3, n_ca_r2: rtl_lint check -assert 4 problems). The die bind must build dsfd_bf_front_roots with the same define.

dsfd_cfifo_crs4.why_land_slots: S81-CORE-LAT-R21 10-27 (COORD S81-CORE-LAT-R20 ruling (a)): face register per landing slot, no added cycle: DSFD_CRS4_LGATE = ot_s81_land GSLOT 1 (each of the D = 4 ring slots written through its own ICG at the same ck_f edges), so every xl<k> bit drives exactly 4 slot flop D pins on xk[k]; bench tools/s81_dv/crs4_bench.py --lgate. The die bind must build dsfd_cfifo_crs4 with the same define.
